task: Classify immune infiltration level in breast cancer as low, medium, or high. On H&E, focus on the density and distribution of stromal and intratumoral lymphocytes and plasma cells relative to the tumor cell component.

classes.0: Low immune class with sparse tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes and little inflammatory stroma.
classes.1: Medium immune class with a moderate lymphocytic infiltrate in tumor stroma or within tumor nests.
classes.2: High immune class with dense stromal and intratumoral lymphocytic infiltration prominently surrounding or permeating tumor.
